blocks.text: Cloud computing sasti ho sakti hai, magar users istemal ki qeemat dete hain aur nigrani na ho to kharcha jaldi barh sakta hai. Istemal aur kharche ka baqaida jaiza lein, wasail ki taqseem behtar karein aur munasib pricing plans chunein. Hardware khareedne ki bajaye sirf istemal shuda wasail ki qeemat dena IT laagat bohat kam kar sakta hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Cloud bill qaboo mein rakhne ke do tareeqe bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Baqaidagi se istemal dekhein aur ghair istemal shuda wasail band karein; asal zaroorat ke mutabiq pricing plan chunein.

items: Pay as you go nigrani aur durust plan ke saath hi paisa bachata hai.
